title: Extras keyed by declaration id
description: Project facts that do not belong in the tracker plans (D12, K8), keyed by absolute declaration id (each must be a node of `tracker graph --all`). Agent-editable; the flags named in the config's `flagged.flags` are the owner's decision (D19). Review tags and fingerprints never go here: they live in the evidence directory (machine) and the attestations file (human), D43/F11. Whether `provider` is required and which values it takes come from the config (`extras.require_provider`, `extras.providers`), so the schema checks only its type.

provider.description: Where the object comes from; one of the config's `extras.providers`.

key.description: A key definition: stands for an object the statement names (full review tiers).

chain.description: A member of the chain of definitions the main statement is built from (D39).

upstream.description: The provider declaration this name re-exports.
